{"path": "/results/toolcalling/silicon_melting_2_trial_2/silicon_melt.in", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for melting silicon and calculating diffusion coefficient

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure
read_data       silicon.data

# Replicate 3x3x3
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Set neighbor list
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Timestep
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs

# Thermodynamic output
thermo          1000
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol

# ============================================
# Stage 1: Initial equilibration at 300K (NPT)
# ============================================
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian
fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             10000
unfix           1

# ============================================
# Stage 2: Heating from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps
# ============================================
# Heating rate: 2.2 K/ps = 0.0022 K/fs
# Temperature change: 2500 - 300 = 2200 K
# Time required: 2200 / 2.2 = 1000 ps = 1,000,000 fs
fix             2 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             1000000
unfix           2

# ============================================
# Stage 3: Equilibration at 2500K for 500 ps
# ============================================
fix             3 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             500000
unfix           3

# ============================================
# Stage 4: Production run with MSD calculation
# ============================================
# Reset timestep counter
reset_timestep  0

# Compute MSD
compute         msd all msd com yes

# Output MSD data
fix             4 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
fix             msd_output all print 100 "$(step) $(c_msd[1]) $(c_msd[2]) $(c_msd[3]) $(c_msd[4])" &
                file msd_data.txt screen no title "# Step MSD_x MSD_y MSD_z MSD_total"

# Run for 500 ps to collect MSD data
run             500000

unfix           4
unfix           msd_output

print           "Simulation completed successfully"
"}

{"path": "/results/toolcalling/silicon_melting_2_trial_2/analyze_msd.py", "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Calculate diffusion coefficient from MSD data using Einstein relation.
D = MSD / (6*t) for 3D diffusion
"""

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', comments='#')
steps = data[:, 0]
msd_total = data[:, 4]  # Total MSD in Angstrom^2

# Convert timestep to time in ps (timestep = 0.001 ps = 1 fs)
time_ps = steps * 0.001

# Einstein relation: MSD = 6*D*t
# D = MSD / (6*t)
# We'll fit the linear region of MSD vs time

# Skip initial transient (first 10% of data)
skip = len(time_ps) // 10
time_fit = time_ps[skip:]
msd_fit = msd_total[skip:]

# Linear fit: MSD = slope * t + intercept
# slope = 6*D
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2 / ps
intercept = coeffs[1]

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D in Angstrom^2/ps
D_A2_ps = slope / 6.0

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# So 1 Angstrom^2/ps = (1e-10)^2 / 1e-12 m^2/s = 1e-8 m^2/s
D_m2_s = D_A2_ps * 1e-8

print(f"MSD data points: {len(steps)}")
print(f"Time range: {time_ps[0]:.2f} to {time_ps[-1]:.2f} ps")
print(f"MSD range: {msd_total[0]:.2f} to {msd_total[-1]:.2f} Angstrom^2")
print(f"\nLinear fit (using last 90% of data):")
print(f"  Slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"  Intercept: {intercept:.6f} Angstrom^2")
print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient:")
print(f"  D = {D_A2_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"  D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"\nFinal Answer: {D_m2_s:.2e}")

# Create plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, slope * time_fit + intercept, 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (slope={slope:.4f} Å²/ps)')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title(f'Mean Squared Displacement at 2500K\nD = {D_m2_s:.2e} m²/s', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Save results to file
with open('diffusion_result.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient of liquid silicon at 2500K\n")
    f.write(f"=" * 50 + "\n\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s\n")
    f.write(f"D = {D_A2_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps\n\n")
    f.write(f"Linear fit parameters:\n")
    f.write(f"  Slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"  Intercept: {intercept:.6f} Angstrom^2\n")
    f.write(f"\nData range: {time_ps[0]:.2f} - {time_ps[-1]:.2f} ps\n")
    f.write(f"Fit range: {time_fit[0]:.2f} - {time_fit[-1]:.2f} ps\n")

print("Results saved to diffusion_result.txt")
"}

-----------
1. Structure: Silicon (mp-149) from Materials Project

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt')
steps = data[:, 0]
msd = data[:, 1]

# Convert steps to time (timestep = 0.001 ps = 1 fs in metal units)
timestep = 0.001  # ps
time = (steps - steps[0]) * timestep  # time in ps

# Plot MSD vs time
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd, 'b-', linewidth=1)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)')
plt.ylabel('MSD (Å²)')
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time')
plt.grid(True)
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
print("MSD plot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Calculate diffusion coefficient using Einstein relation: D = MSD / (6*t)
# Use linear fit to the MSD vs time data to get the slope
# MSD = 6*D*t, so slope = 6*D

# Use the last 80% of data for fitting (to ensure equilibrated region)
fit_start = int(len(time) * 0.2)
time_fit = time[fit_start:]
msd_fit = msd[fit_start:]

# Linear fit
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]
intercept = coeffs[1]

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# slope = 6*D (in Å²/ps)
D_A2_ps = slope / 6.0

# Convert to m²/s
# 1 Å = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# So 1 Å²/ps = 1e-20 / 1e-12 m²/s = 1e-8 m²/s
D_m2_s = D_A2_ps * 1e-8

print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient calculation:")
print(f"Slope of MSD vs time: {slope:.6f} Å²/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_A2_ps:.6e} Å²/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m²/s")

# Also calculate D from individual points in the linear region
D_values = msd_fit / (6.0 * time_fit)
D_mean_A2_ps = np.mean(D_values)
D_mean_m2_s = D_mean_A2_ps * 1e-8

print(f"\nAlternative calculation (mean of D values):")
print(f"Mean diffusion coefficient: {D_mean_A2_ps:.6e} Å²/ps")
print(f"Mean diffusion coefficient: {D_mean_m2_s:.6e} m²/s")

# Plot fitted line
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, slope * time_fit + intercept, 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (slope={slope:.2f} Å²/ps)')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)')
plt.ylabel('MSD (Å²)')
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time with Linear Fit')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.savefig('msd_fit_plot.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
print("MSD fit plot saved as msd_fit_plot.png")

# Save result to file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient (from linear fit): {D_m2_s:.6e} m²/s\n")
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient (from mean): {D_mean_m2_s:.6e} m²/s\n")
    f.write(f"\nFinal result: {D_m2_s:.2e}\n")

print(f"\n{'='*60}")
print(f"FINAL RESULT: {D_m2_s:.2e} m²/s")
print(f"{'='*60}")

units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Thermo output
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol
thermo          1000

# ========================================
# Stage 1: Initial equilibration at 300K (NPT)
# ========================================
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian
fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

unfix           1

fix             3 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Calculate self-diffusion coefficient from MSD data using Einstein relation.
D = lim(t->inf) MSD / (6*t)
Units: metal (LAMMPS) - Angstrom^2/ps -> convert to m^2/s
"""

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', comments='#')
steps = data[:, 0]
msd_total = data[:, 4]  # Total MSD in Angstrom^2

# Convert steps to time (timestep = 0.001 ps = 1 fs)
time_ps = steps * 0.001  # time in ps

# Calculate diffusion coefficient using linear fit in the diffusive regime
# Einstein relation: MSD = 6*D*t
# D = MSD / (6*t)

# Use the linear regime (skip initial transient, use last 80% of data)
start_idx = int(0.2 * len(time_ps))
time_fit = time_ps[start_idx:]
msd_fit = msd_total[start_idx:]

# Linear fit: MSD = slope * t
# D = slope / 6
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
D_angstrom_ps = slope / 6.0  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# 1 Angstrom^2/ps = 1e-20 m^2 / 1e-12 s = 1e-8 m^2/s
D_m2_s = D_angstrom_ps * 1e-8

print(f"Diffusion coefficient calculation:")
print(f"Slope of MSD vs time: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_angstrom_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"\nFinal answer (m^2/s): {D_m2_s:.2e}")

# Save result
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s\n")
    f.write(f"Slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps\n")

# Create plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, np.polyval(coeffs, time_fit), 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (D={D_m2_s:.2e} m²/s)')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time at 2500K', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

{"path": "/results/toolcalling/silicon_melting_2_trial_5/calculate_diffusion.py", "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Calculate diffusion coefficient from MSD data using the Einstein relation.
D = MSD / (6*t)
where MSD is in Angstrom^2 and t is in picoseconds.
"""

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', skiprows=1)
steps = data[:, 0]
msd = data[:, 1]

# Convert steps to time (timestep = 0.001 ps = 1 fs)
timestep = 0.001  # ps
time = (steps - steps[0]) * timestep  # time in ps

# Remove the first point (t=0) to avoid division by zero
time = time[1:]
msd = msd[1:]

# Calculate instantaneous diffusion coefficient at each point
# D = MSD / (6*t) in Angstrom^2/ps
D_inst = msd / (6.0 * time)

# Use linear regression on the MSD vs time to get the slope
# MSD = 6*D*t, so slope = 6*D
from scipy import stats
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(time, msd)
D_from_slope = slope / 6.0  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Average the instantaneous diffusion coefficient over the second half of the data
# (to allow for equilibration)
half_point = len(D_inst) // 2
D_avg = np.mean(D_inst[half_point:])
D_std = np.std(D_inst[half_point:])

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom^2/ps = 1e-20 m^2 / 1e-12 s = 1e-8 m^2/s
conversion = 1e-8
D_avg_SI = D_avg * conversion
D_from_slope_SI = D_from_slope * conversion

print("=" * 60)
print("Diffusion Coefficient Calculation")
print("=" * 60)
print(f"Temperature: 2500 K")
print(f"Number of data points: {len(time)}")
print(f"Time range: {time[0]:.2f} to {time[-1]:.2f} ps")
print(f"MSD range: {msd[0]:.2f} to {msd[-1]:.2f} Angstrom^2")
print()
print("Method 1: Average of instantaneous D (second half of data)")
print(f"  D = {D_avg:.4f} ± {D_std:.4f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"  D = {D_avg_SI:.4e} m^2/s")
print()
print("Method 2: Linear fit of MSD vs time")
print(f"  Slope = {slope:.4f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"  R^2 = {r_value**2:.6f}")
print(f"  D = {D_from_slope:.4f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"  D = {D_from_slope_SI:.4e} m^2/s")
print("=" * 60)
print()
print(f"Final Answer: {D_from_slope_SI:.2e}")
print()

# Create plots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(10, 10))

# Plot 1: MSD vs time
axes[0].plot(time, msd, 'b-', linewidth=0.5, label='MSD data')
axes[0].plot(time, slope * time + intercept, 'r--', linewidth=2, 
             label=f'Linear fit (R²={r_value**2:.4f})')
axes[0].set_xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
axes[0].set_ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)', fontsize=12)
axes[0].set_title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time', fontsize=14)
axes[0].legend()
axes[0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot 2: Instantaneous diffusion coefficient
axes[1].plot(time, D_inst, 'g-', linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7, label='Instantaneous D')
axes[1].axhline(y=D_avg, color='r', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, 
                label=f'Average D (second half) = {D_avg:.4f} Å²/ps')
axes[1].axhline(y=D_from_slope, color='b', linestyle='--', linewidth=2,
                label=f'D from slope = {D_from_slope:.4f} Å²/ps')
axes[1].set_xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
axes[1].set_ylabel('D (Angstrom²/ps)', fontsize=12)
axes[1].set_title('Instantaneous Diffusion Coefficient', fontsize=14)
axes[1].legend()
axes[1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('diffusion_analysis.png', dpi=150)
print("Plot saved as 'diffusion_analysis.png'")
"}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Calculate diffusion coefficient from MSD data using the Einstein relation.
D = MSD / (6*t)
where MSD is in Angstrom^2 and t is in picoseconds.
"""

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', skiprows=1)
steps = data[:, 0]
msd = data[:, 1]

# Convert steps to time (timestep = 0.001 ps = 1 fs)
timestep = 0.001  # ps
time = (steps - steps[0]) * timestep  # time in ps

# Remove the first point (t=0) to avoid division by zero
time = time[1:]
msd = msd[1:]

# Calculate instantaneous diffusion coefficient at each point
# D = MSD / (6*t) in Angstrom^2/ps
D_inst = msd / (6.0 * time)

# Use linear regression on the MSD vs time to get the slope
# MSD = 6*D*t, so slope = 6*D
from scipy import stats
slope, intercept, r_value, p_value, std_err = stats.linregress(time, msd)
D_from_slope = slope / 6.0  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Average the instantaneous diffusion coefficient over the second half of the data
# (to allow for equilibration)
half_point = len(D_inst) // 2
D_avg = np.mean(D_inst[half_point:])
D_std = np.std(D_inst[half_point:])

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom^2/ps = 1e-20 m^2 / 1e-12 s = 1e-8 m^2/s
conversion = 1e-8
D_avg_SI = D_avg * conversion
D_from_slope_SI = D_from_slope * conversion

print("=" * 60)
print("Diffusion Coefficient Calculation")
print("=" * 60)
print(f"Temperature: 2500 K")
print(f"Number of data points: {len(time)}")

print()
print("Method 2: Linear fit of MSD vs time")
print(f"  Slope = {slope:.4f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"  R^2 = {r_value**2:.6f}")
print(f"  D = {D_from_slope:.4f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"  D = {D_from_slope_SI:.4e} m^2/s")
print("=" * 60)
print()
print(f"Final Answer: {D_from_slope_SI:.2e}")
print()

# Plot 1: MSD vs time
axes[0].plot(time, msd, 'b-', linewidth=0.5, label='MSD data')

"""
Analyze MSD data to calculate diffusion coefficient using Einstein relation.
D = MSD / (6*t) for 3D diffusion
"""

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd.dat')
timesteps = data[:, 0]
msd = data[:, 1]

# Convert timesteps to time in picoseconds (timestep = 0.001 ps)
time_ps = timesteps * 0.001

# The Einstein relation: MSD = 6*D*t
# Therefore: D = MSD / (6*t)
# We need to fit the linear region of MSD vs time

# Use the second half of the data for better statistics
# (first part may have transient behavior)
start_idx = len(time_ps) // 2
fit_time = time_ps[start_idx:]
fit_msd = msd[start_idx:]

# Linear fit: MSD = slope * t + intercept
# slope = 6*D
coeffs = np.polyfit(fit_time, fit_msd, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]
intercept = coeffs[1]

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6
D_A2_ps = slope / 6.0  # in Angstrom^2/ps

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# So 1 A^2/ps = (1e-10)^2 / 1e-12 = 1e-8 m^2/s
D_m2_s = D_A2_ps * 1e-8

print(f"Diffusion coefficient analysis:")
print(f"================================")
print(f"Linear fit region: {fit_time[0]:.1f} - {fit_time[-1]:.1f} ps")
print(f"Slope (6D): {slope:.4f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept:.4f} Angstrom^2")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_A2_ps:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"\nFinal answer: {D_m2_s:.2e}")

# Create plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(fit_time, slope * fit_time + intercept, 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (D = {D_m2_s:.2e} m²/s)')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time for Liquid Silicon at 2500K', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_analysis.png', dpi=300)
print(f"\nPlot saved as 'msd_analysis.png'")

# Save results to file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.2e} m^2/s\n")
    f.write(f"Numerical value: {D_m2_s}\n")
"}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Analyze MSD data to calculate diffusion coefficient using Einstein relation.
D = MSD / (6*t) for 3D diffusion
"""

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd.dat')
timesteps = data[:, 0]
msd = data[:, 1]

# Convert timesteps to time in picoseconds (timestep = 0.001 ps)
time_ps = timesteps * 0.001

# The Einstein relation: MSD = 6*D*t
# Therefore: D = MSD / (6*t)
# We need to fit the linear region of MSD vs time

# Use the second half of the data for better statistics
# (first part may have transient behavior)
start_idx = len(time_ps) // 2
fit_time = time_ps[start_idx:]
fit_msd = msd[start_idx:]

# Linear fit: MSD = slope * t + intercept
# slope = 6*D
coeffs = np.polyfit(fit_time, fit_msd, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]
intercept = coeffs[1]

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6
D_A2_ps = slope / 6.0  # in Angstrom^2/ps

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# So 1 A^2/ps = (1e-10)^2 / 1e-12 = 1e-8 m^2/s
D_m2_s = D_A2_ps * 1e-8

print(f"Diffusion coefficient analysis:")
print(f"================================")
print(f"Linear fit region: {fit_time[0]:.1f} - {fit_time[-1]:.1f} ps")
print(f"Slope (6D): {slope:.4f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept:.4f} Angstrom^2")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_A2_ps:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"\nFinal answer: {D_m2_s:.2e}")

# Create plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(fit_time, slope * fit_time + intercept, 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (D = {D_m2_s:.2e} m²/s)')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time for Liquid Silicon at 2500K', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_analysis.png', dpi=300)
print(f"\nPlot saved as 'msd_analysis.png'")

# Save results to file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.2e} m^2/s\n")
    f.write(f"Numerical value: {D_m2_s}\n")

plt.ylabel('MSD (Å²)', fontsize=12)

msd_fit = msd[start_idx:]

# So slope = 6*D
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)

intercept = coeffs[1]

D_A2_ps = slope / 6.0  # Å²/ps

# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting simulation
# Units: metal (Angstroms, eV, ps, K, bar)

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure
read_data       si_structure.data

# Replicate 3x3x3
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Compute settings
compute         msd all msd com yes
compute         temp_all all temp
compute         press_all all pressure temp_all

# Thermo output
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal c_msd[4]
thermo          1000

# Timestep
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs

# ============================================
# Stage 1: Initial equilibration at 300K (NPT)
# ============================================
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian
fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             10000  # 10 ps equilibration at 300K
unfix           1

# ============================================
# Stage 2: Heating from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps
# ============================================
# Heating rate: 2.2 K/ps
# Temperature change: 2500 - 300 = 2200 K
# Time needed: 2200 / 2.2 = 1000 ps
fix             2 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             1000000  # 1000 ps heating
unfix           2

# ============================================
# Stage 3: Equilibration at 2500K for 500 ps
# ============================================
fix             3 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             500000  # 500 ps equilibration
unfix           3

# ============================================
# Stage 4: Production run for MSD calculation
# ============================================
# Reset MSD counter
uncompute       msd
compute         msd all msd com yes

# Run production with MSD tracking
fix             4 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

# Output MSD data
fix             msd_output all print 1000 "$(step) $(c_msd[4])" file msd_data.txt screen no title "# Step MSD"

run             500000  # 500 ps production run
unfix           4
unfix           msd_output

# Silicon Melting Simulation - Results Summary

## Simulation Parameters
- Material: Silicon (mp-149)
- Potential: Stillinger-Weber (SW)
- Initial structure: Diamond cubic, replicated 3×3×3 (216 atoms)
- Units: metal (Å, eV, ps, K, bar)
- Atom style: full
- Timestep: 1 fs (0.001 ps)

## Simulation Protocol
1. **Initial equilibration**: 10 ps at 300K (NPT, P=0)
2. **Heating**: 1000 ps from 300K to 2500K at ~2.5 K/ps (NPT, P=0)
3. **Equilibration at 2500K**: 500 ps (NPT, P=0)
4. **Production run**: 500 ps at 2500K for MSD calculation (NPT, P=0)

## Results

### Diffusion Coefficient at 2500K
- **D = 1.512079 × 10⁻⁸ m²/s**
- D = 1.512079 Å²/ps

### Linear Fit Quality
- Slope: 9.072471 Å²/ps
- R² = 0.995344 (excellent linear fit)

### System Properties at 2500K (liquid phase)
- Temperature: ~2500 K
- Density: ~2.40 g/cm³
- Pressure: ~0 bar (NPT controlled)

## Analysis Method
The diffusion coefficient was calculated using the Einstein relation:
    D = MSD / (6t)

Where MSD is the mean squared displacement and t is time. A linear regression
was performed on the MSD vs time data (skipping the first 10% to avoid initial
transient effects), yielding a slope of 9.072471 Å²/ps with R² = 0.995344.

## Files Generated
- simulation.in: LAMMPS input script
- simulation.log: LAMMPS simulation log
- msd_data.txt: Mean squared displacement data
- diffusion_coefficient.txt: Final results
- msd_plot.png: MSD vs time plot
- msd_fit.png: MSD with linear fit
- heating_analysis.png: Heating phase analysis
- heating_log.csv: Temperature, density, energy data during heating

## Conclusion
The simulation successfully melted silicon from its crystalline state at 300K
to a liquid state at 2500K. The mean squared displacement shows excellent
linear behavior (R² = 0.995), confirming proper diffusive motion in the liquid
phase. The calculated self-diffusion coefficient is **1.512079 × 10⁻⁸ m²/s**.

"""
Analyze MSD data and calculate diffusion coefficient using Einstein relation.
D = lim(t→∞) MSD/(6t)

Units in LAMMPS metal:
- Time: ps
- Distance: Angstrom
- MSD: Angstrom^2
- D: Angstrom^2/ps = 10^-8 m^2/s
"""

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', comments='#')
timestep = data[:, 0]  # timesteps
msd_total = data[:, 4]  # total MSD in Angstrom^2

# Convert timesteps to time in ps (timestep = 0.001 ps)
time_ps = timestep * 0.001

# Einstein relation: MSD = 6*D*t
# D = MSD / (6*t)
# We fit the linear region (typically after initial transient)

# Skip initial transient (first 10% of data)
skip = len(time_ps) // 10
time_fit = time_ps[skip:]
msd_fit = msd_total[skip:]

# Linear fit: MSD = slope * t
# slope = 6*D, so D = slope/6
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Calculate diffusion coefficient

# Convert to m^2/s

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Analyze MSD data and calculate diffusion coefficient using Einstein relation.
D = lim(t→∞) MSD/(6t)

Units in LAMMPS metal:
- Time: ps
- Distance: Angstrom
- MSD: Angstrom^2
- D: Angstrom^2/ps = 10^-8 m^2/s
"""

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', comments='#')
timestep = data[:, 0]  # timesteps
msd_total = data[:, 4]  # total MSD in Angstrom^2

# Convert timesteps to time in ps (timestep = 0.001 ps)
time_ps = timestep * 0.001

# Einstein relation: MSD = 6*D*t
# D = MSD / (6*t)
# We fit the linear region (typically after initial transient)

# Skip initial transient (first 10% of data)
skip = len(time_ps) // 10
time_fit = time_ps[skip:]
msd_fit = msd_total[skip:]

# Linear fit: MSD = slope * t
# slope = 6*D, so D = slope/6
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
D_angstrom2_per_ps = slope / 6.0

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom^2/ps = 10^-20 m^2 / 10^-12 s = 10^-8 m^2/s
D_m2_per_s = D_angstrom2_per_ps * 1e-8

print(f"MSD slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_angstrom2_per_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_per_s:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"\nFinal Answer: {D_m2_per_s:.2e}")

# Plot MSD vs time
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, np.polyval(coeffs, time_fit), 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (slope={slope:.2f} Å²/ps)')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Ų)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Save results
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion Coefficient Analysis\n")
    f.write(f"==============================\n\n")
    f.write(f"MSD slope: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_angstrom2_per_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_per_s:.6e} m^2/s\n")
    f.write(f"\nFinal value: {D_m2_per_s:.2e} m^2/s\n")

print("\nResults saved to diffusion_coefficient.txt")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the MSD data
data = pd.read_csv('msd_data.csv')

# Extract step and MSD columns
steps = data['Step'].values
msd = data['c_msd[4]'].values

# Convert steps to time in ps (timestep = 0.001 ps = 1 fs)
time_ps = steps * 0.001

# Remove the first few points to avoid initial transient behavior
# Use data from 50 ps onwards for fitting
start_idx = np.where(time_ps >= 50)[0][0]
time_fit = time_ps[start_idx:]
msd_fit = msd[start_idx:]

# Perform linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t
# So slope = 6*D, hence D = slope/6
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]
intercept = coeffs[1]

# Calculate diffusion coefficient in Å²/ps
D_A2_ps = slope / 6.0

# Convert to m²/s
# 1 Å = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# So 1 Å²/ps = (1e-10)² / (1e-12) m²/s = 1e-8 m²/s
D_m2_s = D_A2_ps * 1e-8

print(f"Linear fit: MSD = {slope:.6f} * t + {intercept:.6f}")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient D = {D_A2_ps:.6f} Å²/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient D = {D_m2_s:.6e} m²/s")

# Create a plot to visualize the fit
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd, 'b-', label='MSD data', linewidth=2)
plt.plot(time_fit, slope * time_fit + intercept, 'r--', 
         label=f'Linear fit (from {time_fit[0]:.1f} ps)', linewidth=2)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Ų)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=11)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=300)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Also calculate using different time ranges to check consistency
print("\n--- Diffusion coefficient from different time ranges ---")
for start_time in [50, 100, 150, 200]:
    if start_time < time_ps[-1]:
        idx = np.where(time_ps >= start_time)[0][0]
        t_temp = time_ps[idx:]
        msd_temp = msd[idx:]
        coeffs_temp = np.polyfit(t_temp, msd_temp, 1)
        D_temp = (coeffs_temp[0] / 6.0) * 1e-8
        print(f"From {start_time} ps: D = {D_temp:.6e} m²/s")

# Save the result to a file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"{D_m2_s:.6e}\n")
print(f"\nDiffusion coefficient saved to diffusion_coefficient.txt")

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', skiprows=1)

# Extract columns
timestep = data[:, 0]  # timestep
msd_total = data[:, 4]  # Total MSD in Angstrom^2

# Convert timestep to time in picoseconds (timestep = 0.001 ps = 1 fs)
time_ps = timestep * 0.001  # in ps
time_s = time_ps * 1e-12  # in seconds

# Typically after initial transient, MSD vs time becomes linear
# Let's use data from 20 ps to 100 ps for fitting

# Find indices for fitting range (20 ps to 100 ps)
fit_start_ps = 20.0
fit_end_ps = 100.0

fit_indices = np.where((time_ps >= fit_start_ps) & (time_ps <= fit_end_ps))[0]

# Extract data for fitting
time_fit = time_s[fit_indices]
msd_fit = msd_total[fit_indices] * 1e-20  # Convert from Angstrom^2 to m^2

# Perform linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t
# So slope = 6*D, therefore D = slope/6
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # m^2/s

# Calculate diffusion coefficient

print(f"Slope of MSD vs time: {slope:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient D = {D:.6e} m^2/s")

# Plot the linear fit
msd_fit_angstrom = (6 * D * time_fit) * 1e20  # Convert back to Angstrom^2
plt.plot(time_ps[fit_indices], msd_fit_angstrom, 'g--', linewidth=2, label=f'Linear fit: D={D:.2e} m²/s')

plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Ų)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_analysis.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_analysis.png")

# Also save the result to a file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D:.6e} m^2/s\n")
    f.write(f"Formatted answer: {D:.2e}\n")

print("\nResult saved to diffusion_coefficient.txt")
"}

## Task
Calculate the average self diffusion coefficient of liquid silicon at 2500K using molecular dynamics simulations with LAMMPS.

- **Initial Structure**: Crystalline silicon from Materials Project (mp-149)
- **System Size**: 3x3x3 replication of unit cell
- **Potential**: Stillinger-Weber (SW) potential
- **Units**: metal

- Ensemble: NPT (zero external pressure)
- MSD computation: Every 100 timesteps
- Purpose: Calculate mean squared displacement for diffusion coefficient

## Results

- **Linear fit range**: 20-100 ps (after initial transient)
- **Slope of MSD vs time**: 9.204973e-08 m²/s

- MSD shows linear behavior in the fitting region
- Diffusion coefficient is physically reasonable for liquid silicon at 2500K

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt', skiprows=1)

# Extract columns
timestep = data[:, 0]  # timestep
msd_total = data[:, 4]  # Total MSD in Angstrom^2

# Convert timestep to time in picoseconds (timestep = 0.001 ps = 1 fs)
time_ps = timestep * 0.001  # in ps
time_s = time_ps * 1e-12  # in seconds

# For linear fitting, we should use the linear regime
# Typically after initial transient, MSD vs time becomes linear
# Let's use data from 20 ps to 100 ps for fitting

# Find indices for fitting range (20 ps to 100 ps)
fit_start_ps = 20.0
fit_end_ps = 100.0

fit_indices = np.where((time_ps >= fit_start_ps) & (time_ps <= fit_end_ps))[0]

# Extract data for fitting
time_fit = time_s[fit_indices]
msd_fit = msd_total[fit_indices] * 1e-20  # Convert from Angstrom^2 to m^2

# Perform linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t
# So slope = 6*D, therefore D = slope/6
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # m^2/s

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
D = slope / 6.0  # m^2/s

print(f"Linear fit range: {fit_start_ps} ps to {fit_end_ps} ps")
print(f"Slope of MSD vs time: {slope:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient D = {D:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"\nFinal answer (without units): {D:.2e}")

# Create a plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_ps[fit_indices], msd_total[fit_indices], 'r-', linewidth=2, label=f'Fit region ({fit_start_ps}-{fit_end_ps} ps)')

# Plot the linear fit
msd_fit_angstrom = (6 * D * time_fit) * 1e20  # Convert back to Angstrom^2
plt.plot(time_ps[fit_indices], msd_fit_angstrom, 'g--', linewidth=2, label=f'Linear fit: D={D:.2e} m²/s')

plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Ų)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_analysis.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_analysis.png")

# Also save the result to a file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D:.6e} m^2/s\n")
    f.write(f"Formatted answer: {D:.2e}\n")

print("\nResult saved to diffusion_coefficient.txt")

"""
Analyze MSD data and calculate diffusion coefficient using Einstein relation.
D = lim(t->inf) MSD / (6*t)
Units: metal (Angstrom^2/ps) -> m^2/s
"""

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd.dat', comments='#')
time_steps = data[:, 0]  # timesteps
msd_total = data[:, 4]   # total MSD in Angstrom^2

# Convert timesteps to time (ps)
# timestep = 0.001 ps = 1 fs
dt = 0.001  # ps
time = time_steps * dt  # ps

# Use linear fit to the latter part of the MSD curve (after initial transient)
# Typically use the last 50-80% of data for linear regime
start_idx = int(0.3 * len(time))  # Skip first 30%
end_idx = len(time)

time_fit = time[start_idx:end_idx]
msd_fit = msd_total[start_idx:end_idx]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t + b
# slope = 6*D
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
D_metal = slope / 6.0  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# 1 Angstrom^2/ps = 1e-20 m^2 / 1e-12 s = 1e-8 m^2/s
D_SI = D_metal * 1e-8  # m^2/s

print(f"Diffusion coefficient (metal units): {D_metal:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient (SI units): {D_SI:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"Slope of MSD vs time: {slope:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Fit range: {time_fit[0]:.2f} - {time_fit[-1]:.2f} ps")
print(f"Data points used for fitting: {len(time_fit)}")

# Create plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd_total, 'b-', label='MSD data', linewidth=1)
plt.plot(time_fit, np.polyval(coeffs, time_fit), 'r--', 
         label=f'Linear fit (D = {D_SI:.2e} m²/s)', linewidth=2)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement of Liquid Silicon at 2500K', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Save result to file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_SI:.6e} m^2/s\n")
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient (metal units): {D_metal:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"Slope: {slope:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"Fit range: {time_fit[0]:.2f} - {time_fit[-1]:.2f} ps\n")

print(f"\nFinal Answer: {D_SI:.2e}")
"}

"""

msd_fit = msd_total[start_idx:end_idx]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t + b
# slope = 6*D
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
D_metal = slope / 6.0  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# 1 Angstrom^2/ps = 1e-20 m^2 / 1e-12 s = 1e-8 m^2/s

print(f"Diffusion coefficient (metal units): {D_metal:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient (SI units): {D_SI:.6e} m^2/s")

print(f"Fit range: {time_fit[0]:.2f} - {time_fit[-1]:.2f} ps")

         label=f'Linear fit (D = {D_SI:.2e} m²/s)', linewidth=2)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement of Liquid Silicon at 2500K', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Save result to file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_SI:.6e} m^2/s\n")

    f.write(f"Fit range: {time_fit[0]:.2f} - {time_fit[-1]:.2f} ps\n")

print(f"\nFinal Answer: {D_SI:.2e}")

"""

where MSD is in Angstrom^2 and t is in picoseconds.

"""

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt')
steps = data[:, 0]
msd_total = data[:, 4]  # Total MSD in Angstrom^2

# Convert steps to time (timestep = 0.001 ps = 1 fs)
timestep = 0.001  # ps
time = steps * timestep  # ps

# Remove the first point (t=0) to avoid division by zero
time = time[1:]
msd_total = msd_total[1:]

# Calculate diffusion coefficient using Einstein relation: D = MSD / (6*t)
# We'll fit the linear regime to get a more accurate slope

# Use linear regression on the MSD vs time data
# Skip initial transient (use data after 20 ps of production run)
skip_time = 20.0  # ps

    mask = np.ones(len(time), dtype=bool)

time_fit = time[mask]
msd_fit = msd_total[mask]

coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)

# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting simulation
# Heating from 300K to 2500K and equilibration at 2500K

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data silicon.data

# Replicate 3x3x3
replicate 3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber for Si
pair_style sw
pair_coeff * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 10 every 1

# Compute MSD for diffusion coefficient
compute msd all msd com yes

# Thermo output settings
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol c_msd[4]

# Timestep
timestep 0.001  # 1 fs

# ===== Stage 1: Initial equilibration at 300K =====
velocity all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian
fix npt1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run 10000  # 10 ps equilibration at 300K
unfix npt1

# ===== Stage 2: Heating from 300K to 2500K =====
# Heating rate: 2.2 K/ps
# Temperature change: 2500 - 300 = 2200 K
# Time needed: 2200 / 2.2 = 1000 ps = 1,000,000 steps (with 1 fs timestep)
fix npt2 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run 1000000  # 1000 ps heating
unfix npt2

# ===== Stage 3: Equilibration at 2500K =====
# Equilibrate for 500 ps
fix npt3 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run 500000  # 500 ps equilibration
unfix npt3

# ===== Stage 4: Production run for MSD calculation =====
# Reset MSD compute and run production
uncompute msd
compute msd all msd com yes

# Run production for sufficient time to calculate diffusion
# Run for 200 ps with MSD output every 100 steps
fix npt4 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
fix msd_output all print 100 "$(step) $(c_msd[1]) $(c_msd[2]) $(c_msd[3]) $(c_msd[4])" file msd_data.txt screen no title "# Step MSD_x MSD_y MSD_z MSD_total"
run 200000  # 200 ps production
unfix npt4
unfix msd_output

print "Simulation completed successfully"

coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2 / ps

print("\nResults saved to diffusion_coefficient.txt")

# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting and diffusion calculation
# Units: metal (Angstrom, ps, eV, K, bars)

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure
read_data       silicon.data

# Replicate 3x3x3
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Timestep
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs in metal units

# Compute MSD for diffusion calculation
compute         msd all msd com yes

# Thermo output
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal c_msd[4]
thermo          1000

# ========================================
# Stage 1: Initial equilibration at 300K
# ========================================
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian

fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             10000  # 10 ps equilibration
unfix           1

# ========================================
# Stage 2: Heating from 300K to 2500K
# Heating rate: 2.2 K/ps
# Temperature change: 2200 K
# Time needed: 2200/2.2 = 1000 ps
# ========================================
fix             2 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             1000000  # 1000 ps heating
unfix           2

# ========================================
# Stage 3: Equilibration at 2500K for 500 ps
# ========================================
fix             3 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             500000  # 500 ps equilibration
unfix           3

# ========================================
# Stage 4: Production run at 2500K for MSD calculation
# Reset MSD and run for sufficient time
# ========================================
# Reset MSD compute
uncompute       msd
compute         msd all msd com yes

fix             4 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

# Dump MSD data frequently for accurate diffusion calculation
dump            1 all custom 100 msd_data.dump id type x y z
dump_modify     1 sort id

# Output MSD data to file
fix             msd_output all print 100 "$(step) $(c_msd[4])" file msd.dat screen no title "# Step MSD"

run             500000  # 500 ps production run
unfix           4
unfix           msd_output
undump          1

print           "Simulation completed successfully"

"""
Calculate self-diffusion coefficient from MSD data using Einstein relation.
D = MSD / (6*t)
"""

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd_data.txt')

# Extract columns: step, msd_x, msd_y, msd_z, msd_total
steps = data[:, 0]
msd_total = data[:, 4]  # Total MSD in Angstrom^2

# Convert steps to time (ps)
# timestep = 0.001 ps, output every 100 steps
timestep = 0.001  # ps
output_freq = 100
time_ps = steps * timestep  # time in ps

# Convert time to seconds
time_s = time_ps * 1e-12  # ps to s

# Convert MSD from Angstrom^2 to m^2
msd_m2 = msd_total * 1e-20  # Angstrom^2 to m^2

# Use Einstein relation: MSD = 6*D*t
# D = MSD / (6*t)
# We'll fit the linear region to get the slope

# Skip initial non-linear region (first 10% of data)
skip = len(time_s) // 10
time_fit = time_s[skip:]
msd_fit = msd_m2[skip:]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t
# Slope = 6*D
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]
diffusion_coeff = slope / 6.0

print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {diffusion_coeff:.6e} m²/s")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient (scientific): {diffusion_coeff}")

# Save result
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"{diffusion_coeff:.6e}\n")

# Create plot for verification
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd_total, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)')
plt.ylabel('MSD (Ų)')
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
print("Plot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Also plot in SI units with fit
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_s, msd_m2, 'b-', linewidth=1, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, slope * time_fit + coeffs[1], 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (D = {diffusion_coeff:.3e} m²/s)')
plt.xlabel('Time (s)')
plt.ylabel('MSD (m²)')
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time (SI units)')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.savefig('msd_plot_si.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
print("SI plot saved as msd_plot_si.png")
"}
